question: What is the meaning of robustness in relation to technical information?
description: Robustness in relation to technical information refers to the ability of the information to remain reliable and accurate under various conditions, including changes in technology, usage, and environmental factors. It signifies the resilience of the technical information to maintain its integrity and usefulness over time and across different scenarios.
